headline: Fortnite creators get 36 AI-powered character personas starting July 30
summary: Epic Games is enabling creators to publish experiences featuring characters with AI-generated voices, using performances from professional actors.
details: Fortnite creators will soon be able to publish experiences featuring characters with AI-powered voices. Epic Games has developed 36 distinct characters with consistent voices and personas for creators to use as NPCs.

These new AI personas include popular Fortnite characters such as Agent Jonesy, Peely the banana, Fishstick, and Cuddle Team Leader. The voices are derived from performances captured by independent professional actors specifically for this purpose.

Epic Games previously experimented with AI voices in Fortnite with the Darth Vader NPC, which utilized James Earl Jones' voice. Although players found ways to make Vader swear, Epic quickly addressed the issue and announced plans to allow creators to develop their own AI characters.

The company aims to eventually secure rights to use the original voices of well-known actors who have appeared in the Fortnite universe. This next step involves working with relevant guilds and voice actors to explore these possibilities.
Epic has also established ground rules for creators testing their own AI characters to prevent problematic content and ensure a safe environment within the Fortnite ecosystem.
caption:
Fortnite is unleashing 36 AI-powered character personas for creators to use in their experiences starting July 30th.

Fortnite creators will soon be able to publish experiences featuring characters with AI-powered voices. Epic Games has developed 36 distinct characters with consistent voices and personas for creators to use as NPCs.

These new AI personas include popular Fortnite characters such as Agent Jonesy, Peely the banana, Fishstick, and Cuddle Team Leader. The voices are derived from performances captured by independent professional actors specifically for this purpose.

Epic Games previously experimented with AI voices in Fortnite with the Darth Vader NPC, which utilized James Earl Jones' voice. Although players found ways to make Vader swear, Epic quickly addressed the issue and announced plans to allow creators to develop their own AI characters.

The company aims to eventually secure rights to use the original voices of well-known actors who have appeared in the Fortnite universe. This next step involves working with relevant guilds and voice actors to explore these possibilities.

Epic has also established ground rules for creators testing their own AI characters to prevent problematic content and ensure a safe environment within the Fortnite ecosystem.
